test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Constitution (Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes) Orders (Second Amendment) Bill, 2022 has recognised the _______community as a Schedule Tribe in some parts of Uttar Pradesh.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gonds**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Gonds have been recognized as a Schedule Tribe in some parts of Uttar Pradesh through the Constitution (Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes) Orders **(Second Amendment) Bill, 2022**.
 
• The Gonds are an ethnolinguistic group in India who call themselves **"Koitur"**.
 
• Gondi, their mother tongue, is a member of the **Dravidian language** family.
 
• The Gondi community has been featured in two major films: **S.S. Rajamouli's 2022 blockbuster RRR and the 2017 Amit V. Masurkar film Newton**.
 
• Gonds are one of the largest tribal communities in India, primarily found in central India, including the states of **Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra, and parts of Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Erukala:**

 
 
• It is a community in **Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• Although** Yerukala** is their mother tongue, the majority now speak Telugu.
 
 
 
• **Bhils:**
 
 
• These are a large tribal community primarily found in western India, including the states of **Rajasthan, Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Madhya Pradesh**. 
 
• A subgroup of the Western Zone of the Indo-Aryan languages, they speak the **Bhil languages**.
 
 
 
• **Chenchus:**
 
 
• These are another tribal community primarily found in **Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, and parts of Karnataka**. 
 
• The Dravidian language family includes the **Chenchu language**, which is spoken by the Chenchu people.
